data.one_liner: Dart-only Amplify API plugin for GraphQL and REST.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart-only implementation of the Amplify API plugin, enabling GraphQL queries, mutations, subscriptions, and REST operations. It supports WebSocket reconnection and wasm for web builds.
use_when: You need to interact with AWS Amplify API from a pure Dart project
You require GraphQL subscriptions or REST calls without Flutter widgets
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter app that already uses the amplify_flutter plugin
You need a higher-level abstraction or code generation for models
strengths: Works on all platforms (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux)
weaknesses: Only a Dart library, no Flutter widgets
Requires manual handling of models and serialization
Limited to Amplify API, not other backends
